scope: 192 exact prefix replays: all E48 conditions/controllers/cases. Stop after 16 descent steps (0.64 s), or earlier task termination. Episode outcomes are inherited from E48, not new full-episode evaluations. No controller intervention, tuning or training.
diagnostics: Log the actual damped-Jacobian motion term, pre-update bias, raw sum, clipped action, executed command, measured dq, singular values and pose response. Command_jump compares each descent action with the last probe command; only the first value is the handoff discontinuity. Diagnostic only.
